page.layout: One page of running text, full width. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Catchword at the right foot and gathering signature at the left foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: missionem:Erudiam te,&docebo te qua via ambules: dirigam te oculo meo:Psal. 32.8. Item: Et est vir ille tanquam arbor plantata secundum fluenta aquarū, quae fructum suum dabit in tempore suo: & folium eius non marcescit: & quicquid facit, prosperum est. Psal.i.3.

5. Deum ὁδηγὸν[?] sequuntur: & ficubi cat[?]nis intemperie abrepti deflexerunt, in viam se reduci petunt, & cū Dauide precantur: Errores quis intelligat? ab occultis munda me: Psal.19.12. Item: Vias tuas, Jehouah, fac me scire: semitas tuas doce me. Dirige me in veritate tua,& doce mei[?]: quoniam tu es Deus liberator meus: te expecto toto die: Psal.25.4.5. Caetera dissimilitudinis fidelium & infidelium capita consulto nunc praetereo.
main_text.head: VERSUS VIII.
main_text.p: Quia tu spoliasti gentes multas, spolia-bunt te omnes reliqui populi,propter san-guinem hominum,& violentiam terræ & ciuitatis, omnium habitantium in ea. Αἰτιολογία[?] est. Prædixerat Jehouah, Chaldæorū opes diripiendas esse à Gentibus: quæ oratio non minus mira vide-

page.notes: Page number read as 143 (the final glyph resembles a 5 but matches the Psalm references, e.g. Ps. 1:3). The word at the line end "cat" / "nis" has no visible hyphen and its reading is doubtful. "doce mei" is doubtful; the scan may read "me". The Greek ὁδηγὸν and Αἰτιολογία are doubtful in their letters. The catchword "ripo-" and the signature "q 2" are doubtful. The line-end "vide-" is printed with a hyphen; the next word is not visible. The running head is set in capitals and was read as HABACVC, normalised to HABACUC.
